purpose: Compare model source pruning while preserving the existing native execution path.
revision_evidence_limit: Existing local provenance record. No new remote revision verification.
hardware: Apple M4, 10 GPU cores, 16 GiB unified memory

workload.precision: Existing CPU/Accelerate F32 body and Metal W8 head/MLP path

control.source: The same final working-tree snapshot for both builds.
control.baseline: All existing model features plus accelerate and metal-w8.
control.candidate: Qwen3.5 model feature only plus accelerate and metal-w8.
control.profile: Cargo release defaults, without variant-specific LTO or stripping.
control.network: Offline Cargo builds with the same existing lockfile.
control.source_pruning_proof: Inspect Rust dependency files and native build outputs. Do not infer pruning from executable size.

build_measurement.clean: Each build uses a new Cargo target directory. The dependency download cache remains warm.
build_measurement.noop: Repeat the identical build command without changing inputs.
build_measurement.incremental: Rebuild after a comment-only edit to the snapshot CLI source.

generation_measurement.request_boundary: Reset through generation completion and returned token IDs.
generation_measurement.load_boundary: Model construction includes weight preparation and Metal initialization.
generation_measurement.startup_probe: CLI --help process latency, separate from model loading.
generation_measurement.quality_check: Require identical token IDs across both build selections for every measured case.
generation_measurement.quality_limit: This small suite checks pruning regressions. It does not certify general model quality.

claims.build: Report observed times and sample counts. A small sample does not prove a universal speedup.
claims.runtime: Report same-path inference separately from build cost and executable size.
claims.scope: This first experiment prunes model families. It does not prove removal of every unused operator.
claims.aot: Existing runtime Metal source compilation remains in scope and must be disclosed.
